integrity: All dimension counts and the tangent-space argument were reconstructed directly from the twenty-one displayed parameter families. The packaged checker verifies the linear ranks and the nontrivial finite Jacobian steps; no finite sampling is used as a substitute for an algebraic proof.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion is a reduced-set/Zariski-closure consequence of the published complete classification. It does not determine irreducible components, multiplicities, tangent cones, local analytic type, or the real conjugacy slice, and it does not independently reproduce the source paper's full elimination computation.
title: Codimension eight and tangent excess six for the weakly persistent isochronous cubic locus
